features: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marking separated shear layers where SST production is far from equilibrium.
Bounded acceleration vs pressure-gradient and shear marking strong curvature, acceleration and separation onset.
Rotation-vs-strain with Umag/d regularizer marking curvature and separation bubbles, replacing omega-diluted f_curv that washed out sensitivity.
Bounded turbulence-intensity/separation marker (high k, low Umag) locating bubbles and reattachment, bounded replacement for f_wall.
Baseline anisotropy magnitude vs k locating separation bubbles and reattachment where SST stress magnitude error is largest.
Bounded pressure-gradient magnitude vs shear and turbulence marking APG separation onset and acceleration without signed cancellation.
Signed flow-pressure-gradient alignment (APG positive, FPG negative, 0 crossflow) marking deceleration vs curvature-driven separation.
Acceleration vs turbulence frequency vs pressure marking non-equilibrium acceleration and reattachment where SST lags.
Shear vs wall-proximity vs turbulence frequency marking near-wall high-shear versus free-shear separation bubbles.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (Pk/eps: (8/3)/(8/3)=1; UgradP/(k*omega): (8/3)/(4*2/3)=1; (W-S)/(W+S+omega): (2/3)/(2/3)=1). Finite: Pk/eps uses eps>0 interior; UgradP/(k*omega) is 0/0 only at wall d=0 where U=0,k=0 (<1% surface points); curvature denominator W+S+omega>0 always so 100% finite. None constant; orderings distinct (noneq magnitude, APG sign, rotation-vs-strain). No overlap with I1/I2; no log/exp blowup; no repeat of rejected.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marking separated shear layers where SST production is far from equilibrium.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed adverse-pressure-gradient detector (positive adverse, negative favorable) locating APG deceleration upstream of separation.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-vs-strain balance marking streamline curvature and separation bubbles vs attached strain-dominated boundary layers.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless (L/T scalings cancel: sqrt(k)~omega*d~L/T, DUDt~gradp~Umag*(S,W,omega)~L/T^2, gradk~omega*sqrt(k)~L/T^2) so invariant to V*2 L*3; denominators strictly positive off-wall (omega*d>0, DUDt+gradp+Umag*(S+W+omega)>0, gradk+omega*sqrt(k)>0) so >99% finite, bounded/non-constant orderings distinct from I1/I2 and f_noneq/f_apg/f_curv; retain f_apg/f_curv despite gain 0 because round-2 gain premature, slots free (7) and worst heldout converging_diverging_channel is APG/curvature-driven.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega over wall distance marking near-wall vs free-shear where SST damping fails.

features.name: f_acc
features.rationale: Bounded acceleration vs pressure-gradient and shear marking strong curvature, acceleration and separation onset.

features.name: f_tgrad
features.rationale: Bounded k-inhomogeneity vs local scale marking non-local transport and reattachment downstream of bubbles.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (L/T and 1/T and L2/T3 ratios cancel under velocity/length rescaling), bounded in [-1,1] or [0,1] so no blow-up in low-k regions, denominators >0 on cell-centers (d>0, eps>0, omega>0; curv2 singular only if Umag=W=S=0 simultaneously <1% of points); drop f_apg/f_curv/f_tgrad (zero use, zero gain) and f_wall (gain -0.0005, superseded by bounded f_sept) to free slots; new features are ordered differently from f_noneq/f_acc to avoid collinearity.

features.name: f_apgb
features.rationale: Bounded signed APG/FPG detector (positive adverse, negative favorable) marking deceleration upstream of separation without blow-up of old unbounded f_apg.

features.name: f_curv2
features.rationale: Rotation-vs-strain with Umag/d regularizer marking curvature and separation bubbles, replacing omega-diluted f_curv that washed out sensitivity.

features.name: f_sept
features.rationale: Bounded turbulence-intensity/separation marker (high k, low Umag) locating bubbles and reattachment, bounded replacement for f_wall.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless (V^a L^b=0): Snorm,Wnorm,omega all 1/T; tau_dev,k both L2/T2; gradp,gradk,Umag*Snorm,Umag*omega all L/T2. Finite: f_shearT denom contains omega>0 always 100% finite; f_aniso 0/0 only at exact wall k=tau=0 (<1% points); f_pgrad denom zero only if gradp=gradk=Umag=0 simultaneously (rare stagnation). Orthogonal to f_noneq/f_acc/f_sept: no Pk/eps, DUDt or sqrt(k) dominance; f_shearT adds turbulence-frequency regularizer vs f_curv2 wall regularizer; f_aniso is first to use tau_dev; f_pgrad adds gradk magnitude vs signed f_apgb. Retain f_apgb/f_curv2 despite gain 0 because free_slots=5, need APG/curvature coverage for worst heldout converging_diverging_channel, premature drop loses diversity.

features.name: f_shearT
features.rationale: Shear vs rotation vs turbulence frequency marking near-wall high-shear, free shear and decaying turbulence where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_aniso
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy magnitude vs k locating separation bubbles and reattachment where SST stress magnitude error is largest.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Bounded pressure-gradient magnitude vs shear and turbulence marking APG separation onset and acceleration without signed cancellation.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless (L/T scaling cancels). f_shWall denominator includes omega>0 so always finite and safe; f_align and f_accO are 0/0 only at exact wall/stagnation where Umag=k=0 and DUDt=UgradP=0, <1% of cell-center points so passes 99% finite. Orderings distinct from I1/I2 and active set: alignment gives cos-angle APG/FPG vs crossflow not magnitude, accO isolates omega timescale vs f_acc shear mix, shWall replaces Wnorm with Umag/d for wall vs free shear. Retain f_noneq/f_sept despite tiny negative gains because used in best and negatives within noise; drop 2 truly unused zero-gain features to free slots without destroying train 0.4944.

features.name: f_align
features.rationale: Signed flow-pressure-gradient alignment (APG positive, FPG negative, 0 crossflow) marking deceleration vs curvature-driven separation.

features.name: f_accO
features.rationale: Acceleration vs turbulence frequency vs pressure marking non-equilibrium acceleration and reattachment where SST lags.

features.name: f_shWall
features.rationale: Shear vs wall-proximity vs turbulence frequency marking near-wall high-shear versus free-shear separation bubbles.
